rules.note: Not listed in the official requirements. Host universities such as Shanghai University ask for a clear passport information page.
Not listed in the official requirements. Shanghai University asks for a recent bareheaded one-inch photo (JPG under 100KB); check your host university.
Proof of your previous qualification (high school diploma, bachelor's or master's). If not yet issued, a pre-graduation certificate from your school.
Transcripts of your highest programme, sealed by your school or university. The scholarship needs outstanding academic results.
The official guide asks for a new-format HSK certificate (generally Level 4). Needed for Chinese-taught programmes; some universities ask for HSK 5 or 6.
Only if your programme is taught in English and English is not your native language. Check your host university for the accepted tests and scores.
CSCA score report (China Scholastic Competency Assessment). Shanghai University and SUFE require it for bachelor applicants; take the test before the deadline.
For pre-college (preparatory) study: a pre-admission letter for an undergraduate programme from a Shanghai university.
Shanghai University asks for two signed letters from professors or associate professors, in English or Chinese. Check your host university.
Shanghai University asks for two signed letters from professors or associate professors, in English or Chinese. Check your host university.
Shanghai University asks for a personal statement with a study plan and research proposal (over 800 words). Check your host university.
Only for art majors: examples of your work (Shanghai University asks for at least two artworks).
Evidence of published papers or patents, if you have them.
Shanghai University asks for a certificate of no criminal record, or a signed commitment if you cannot obtain one. Check your host university.
Shanghai University asks for a statement of financial support. Check your host university.
Shanghai University asks for a selfie video (self-introduction and study plan, MP4 under 50MB) in the language of your programme.
The Shanghai Government Scholarship application form, completed and signed (Shanghai Maritime University uploads it as the one required item). Add award certificates if you have them.
